summary: Count to 20, count up to 10 things one by one, know the last number is how many, see up to 4 at a glance.
Name the written numbers 0 to 10, match them to groups of up to 10, and begin writing them.
Tell when two groups are the same by matching or counting, and say which of two numbers to 10 is bigger.
Put small numbers together and break them apart to solve problems with fewer than 5 things.
Make up a new simple repeating pattern of your own and keep it going.
Sort a group of things in more than one way and explain how they were sorted.
Fill shape puzzles with pattern blocks, and say where things are: above, below, beside, between.
Tell shapes apart by their sides and corners, and tell flat shapes from solid ones, like a square from a cube.
Use time words like earlier and later, morning and afternoon, about the day.
Compare two or more things by length, weight or size, and play at measuring with rulers and cups.
